title: Payments and checkout flow
summary: A checkout that never double-charges and never loses an order: idempotent payment intents, Apple Pay, 3-D Secure, and clear recovery when the app dies mid-payment.
requirements: Cart → checkout → pay with card or Apple Pay → confirmation; support 3-D Secure challenges.
Exactly-once charging even with retries and app crashes.
PCI scope minimized: card data never touches our servers in raw form.
components: Order service creates an order and a payment intent (with idempotency key) server-side
Payment provider SDK (Stripe/Adyen) for card tokenization and 3DS; PassKit for Apple Pay
Client checkout state machine persisted locally (orderID, intentID, step)
Webhooks from the provider to the backend as the source of truth for payment status
tradeoffs: Client-confirmed payments feel faster; server-confirmed via webhooks are authoritative. Show 'processing' until the server confirms.
Native UI gives the best UX; provider-hosted sheets reduce PCI scope and maintenance.
Aggressive retries recover more payments but risk duplicates without idempotency keys.
body: **Flow:** client `POST /orders` (Idempotency-Key = cart snapshot UUID) → server returns orderID + client secret → client collects payment (Apple Pay token or tokenized card) → confirm with provider → handle 3DS challenge if required → poll/subscribe to order status until `paid` or `failed`.
**Crash recovery:** persist the checkout step; on relaunch, if an order is `pendingPayment`, ask the server for status instead of re-charging.
**Apple Pay:** `PKPaymentRequest` with merchant ID, supported networks, line items; the token goes to the provider; requires domain/merchant validation for web.
**Security:** never log card data, use the provider's tokenization, App Attest on checkout endpoints to reduce fraud, jailbreak signals only as risk input.
**Metrics:** checkout conversion by step, payment failure reasons, 3DS challenge rate, time to confirmation.

code.caption: Checkout state
code.text:
enum CheckoutStep: Codable {
    case cart
    case creatingOrder(idempotencyKey: UUID)
    case awaitingPayment(orderID: String, clientSecret: String)
    case confirming(orderID: String)
    case requiresAction(orderID: String, redirect: URL)    // 3DS
    case completed(orderID: String)
    case failed(orderID: String?, reason: String)
}
